prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1401; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained serious injuries as a result of this collision and is entitled to compensation under the applicable policy and law.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in writing, or in person. If you are represented by counsel in this matter, please forward this letter to them immediately.

We request that you provide a complete copy of the policy in force at the time of the collision, including a declarations page showing all liability limits and any applicable coverages. We also ask that you confirm in writing the bodily injury and property damage limits available under the policy.

Finally, we demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including vehicle data, photographs, witness statements, recorded calls, claim file materials, and any dashcam or telematics records. Any loss or destruction of such evidence will be brought to the court's attention.
